crew.overview: A look at how climate change affects our environment and what society can do to prevent the demise of endangered species, ecosystems, and native communities across the planet.
crew.title: Before the Flood

details.biography: Antonio (Tony) Rossi has had a career as a Director of Photography spanning more than 25 years. In that time, he has worked on close to 200 documentaries. The Italian born and US raised cinematographer is inspired and enthralled by the range of the human experience, and his work is committed to allowing people to tell their stories in an expressive, beautiful and dignified manner.
details.name: Antonio Rossi
